actions.description: Capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference.
actions.name: cap_sensing_image_v1

facts.text: The camera component stores its private topic root as the literal "~/".
initVideoDepthPublishers names the RGB sensor prefix "rgb/", the color mode "color/", the rectified variant "rect/" and the image suffix "image".
make_topic concatenates the private root with those parts and resolves the result through the node's topic interface, so "~/" acquires the deployed node name and namespace.
The RGB image topic is built with make_topic(sens_rgb, color, rectified, type_image).
The pinned changelog records the renamed RGB topic literal "~/rgb/color/rect/image".
SlImageAdapter is a TypeAdapter from StampedSlMat to sensor_msgs::msg::Image, so the adapter publishes a standard Image message on that topic.
The adapter copies the matrix height, width, row step and host byte order into the ROS Image message.
The adapter maps U8_C3 matrices to BGR8 and U8_C4 matrices to BGRA8.
The common stereo configuration defaults enable_24bit_output to false and documents that false selects BGRA 32-bit output.
The launch file defaults camera_name to zed and node_name to zed_node, and loads the composable node with namespace and name set from those values.
When the namespace launch argument is empty, the launch file sets the namespace to the camera name.
The video.publish_rgb parameter is read into the mPublishImgRgb topic-selection flag.
initVideoDepthPublishers creates the RGB publisher pair only inside the mPublishImgRgb branch.
The common stereo configuration sets video.publish_rgb to true.
The node creates reset_odometry and reset_pos_tracking std_srvs Trigger services and a zed_msgs SetPose service only when position tracking is enabled.
callback_resetOdometry sets mResetOdomFromSrv and returns success; it performs no camera stream stop or power-off.
